attributes.note_text: Case B origin: visible sensing resolution. Healthy acquisition/FoV status is not proof that a small target can be recognized.

Case C1-SW concerns suppression or late delivery of a usable thermal-supported hypothesis at objectListOut by the intended fusion policy. The catalog FI Sensor-fusion integration issue and TCs Partial occlusion and Cluttered background describe its mechanism and triggering conditions. It contributes to system Case C1 before TigerDetectionApp classification. SWREQ_SEN_004 and SWREQ_SEN_007 are allocated to Fusion in ARXML notes and satisfy TDS_SEN_004 and TDS_SEN_007 in the RST requirements. Runtime measure SOTIF_RT_002 and its validation remain open. Implementation faults stay in SW_Safety_Analysis. Case D describes insufficient combined input information at system level, while C1-SW describes suppression of usable information. Case E is the system outcome of an undetected actual capability limitation; the intended ComputeUnit.assessOperatingCapability assessment is allocated to Fusion and feeds TigerDetectionApp. SOTIF_RT_003 addresses capability qualification and the unavailable indication, with implementation and validation open.

Case C2 assesses thermal contrast discrimination after runtime measure SOTIF_RT_001 adds LWIR sensing for Case C1. LWIR blockage, calibration and contrast estimates are separate from RGB status and require independent validation.

Cases A, B, C1 and C2 are system-level scenario outcomes. Case C1 motivates thermal runtime measure SOTIF_RT_001; follow-up Case C2 assesses its limitation under low thermal contrast. Case A-SW contributes a classifier output insufficiency to system Case A. Case C1-SW contributes suppression of usable thermal evidence by Fusion to system Case C1 and motivates open runtime measure SOTIF_RT_002. These SW contributions are not separate independent hazardous scenarios. Validate the complete sensing, fusion, classification and warning chain, including any compensating mechanisms. Case D covers insufficient combined RGB/lidar/LWIR information with functioning sensors. It contributes to B for small targets and C2 for low thermal contrast only when complementary sensing cannot compensate. Case E covers an actual capability limitation that the intended estimator fails to recognize. D-to-E additionally requires the estimator insufficiency; the propagation graph is not an AND-gate model. Cases A/A-SW and C1-SW can occur within valid operating conditions and have no automatic propagation to E. Runtime measure SOTIF_RT_003 and validation of the D/E capability boundary and unavailable indication remain open. All three channels remain required.

Case A-SW concerns a pose-dependent false-negative output during correct execution and contributes to system Case A. Its tasks isolate the SW component boundary. SW requirement IDs are allocated in ARXML DESC notes and trace to system requirements through the RST satisfies attributes. Implementation faults remain in the SW fault analysis.
